toegepas.blok: Minder as 'n dag na 'n ander wêrelddeel
toegepas.voor: in minder as een dag daar.
toegepas.na: in minder as een dag daarheen.
toegepas.rede_vinder: With a verb of motion ('bring') Afrikaans uses the directional 'daarheen', not 'daar'.
toegepas.fout: 'bring jou ... daar' uses the locative 'daar' with a verb of motion, copying English 'get you there'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The directional 'daarheen' is the correct Afrikaans after 'bring', and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Vliegtuie dra ook goedere en ons noem
toegepas.na: Vliegtuie dra ook goedere, en ons noem
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('Vliegtuie dra', 'ons noem').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: Wat 'n vliegtuig wel bo 'n skip het, is
toegepas.na: Wat 'n vliegtuig wel op 'n skip voor het, is
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Bo iets hê' copies English 'have over'; the Afrikaans idiom for an advantage is 'iets op ... voor hê'.
toegepas.fout: 'iets bo 'n skip hê' copies English 'have over'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Iets op ... voor hê' is the Afrikaans idiom for an advantage, and the meaning is the same.

toegepas.blok: Waar daar geen aanloopbaan is nie
toegepas.voor: 'n Helikopter se lang vlerke draai bo-op hom rond en lig hom reguit op.
toegepas.na: Die lang vlerke bo-op 'n helikopter draai rond en lig dit reguit op.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The block calls the aeroplane 'dit' but the helicopter 'hy/hom'; standard Afrikaans uses 'dit' for a machine, and this keeps the block consistent (apply together with the next two changes).
toegepas.fout: 'se lang vlerke draai bo-op hom rond en lig hom' is clumsy, and the block calls the aeroplane 'dit' but the helicopter 'hy/hom'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal reads more plainly, says the same thing, and makes the pronoun consistent; kept together with 7 and 8.

toegepas.blok: Waar daar geen aanloopbaan is nie
toegepas.voor: Daarom kan hy land op plekke waar
toegepas.na: Daarom kan dit op plekke land waar
toegepas.rede_vinder: Pronoun consistent with 'dit' for the helicopter, and the infinitive moved before the relative clause as standard word order prefers.
toegepas.fout: Pronoun 'hy' for the helicopter is inconsistent with 'dit' once change 6 is applied.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Needed for consistency with change 6, and the standard word order reads more smoothly without changing the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Waar daar geen aanloopbaan is nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The previous sentence is about hospitals, so a pronoun here is ambiguous; naming the helicopter makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'Hy' follows a sentence whose subject is 'Sommige hospitale', so the reader has to look back, and it would clash with 'dit' after changes 6 and 7.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the helicopter makes the reference clear and keeps the block consistent, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: klim die passasiers uit en werkers laai
toegepas.na: klim die passasiers uit, en werkers laai
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses with their own subjects ('die passasiers', 'werkers').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses ('die passasiers klim uit', 'werkers laai').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The attributive adjective 'gelyk' takes the inflected form 'gelyke' before the noun.
toegepas.fout: The attributive adjective 'gelyk' is uninflected before the noun.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Gelyke' is the correct inflected form; this is a plain grammar fix that does not change the definition.

laat_vaar.blok: Minder as 'n dag na 'n ander wêrelddeel
laat_vaar.voor: honderde mense op een vlug dra.
laat_vaar.na: honderde mense op een vlug vervoer.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Vervoer' is the natural verb for carrying passengers and matches the glossary definition; 'dra' stays for cargo.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dra' for what a vehicle can hold is acceptable, and the next block's 'Vliegtuie dra ook goedere' leans on the same verb, so the swap disturbs a neighbour.

laat_vaar.blok: Minder as 'n dag na 'n ander wêrelddeel
laat_vaar.na: oor die wêreld heen versprei is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The idiomatic form is 'oor die wêreld heen versprei'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Oor die wêreld versprei' already reads naturally; adding 'heen' is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.voor: opstyg en land en mense inklim
na_skrywer.na: opstyg en land, en waar mense inklim
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Two 'en's in a row blur the structure; repeating 'waar' separates the two clauses clearly without changing the meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: The run of 'en ... en' in the glossary definition blurs which clause 'mense inklim' belongs to.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this rewords a shared glossary definition beyond spelling or grammar, so only the writer may change it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: Block heading: cargo cannot itself be 'haastig'; something like cargo that must arrive quickly is meant. Left unchanged because a heading may be the block's key; for the writer to judge.

vlae.teks: Jou foon vang daardie seine op en werk self uit waar jy is.
vlae.rede: 'Daardie seine' points back to signals the text never names as signals (the previous sentence says the satellites send out their time and place); a Grade 4 reader may not make the link. Not changed because fixing it means adding a word about what the satellites send.
